products.name: Incline
products.tagline: Balanced high-mountain water, for the table.
products.lead: From a glacier-fed spring high above the Kullu Valley. Crisp, balanced and quiet on the palate: the water that lets the table do the talking.
products.story: Incline takes its name from the steep slopes above its source. Snowmelt seeps through granite and alpine meadow at about 2,500 metres and surfaces as a spring from a high cleft in the rock. We keep just enough of what the rock gives it for a smooth, balanced mouthfeel, and bottle it in clear glass so you can see exactly what you are pouring.
products.metaDescription: OnyxAura Incline: glacier-fed Himalayan spring water in a 700 ml clear glass bottle. pH 7.5 to 7.9, TDS 80 to 120 ppm. MRP ₹399. Order online.

source.terrain: Alpine meadow, pine forest and granite
source.climate: Around 4 °C through the year, with heavy winter snow
source.day: The spring is checked at first light every morning, before anything is drawn.

points: pH 7.5 to 7.9 and TDS 80 to 120 ppm: a soft, balanced profile.
Sand and carbon, micron filtration, minerals balanced, then ozone and UV.
Clear 700 ml glass, with a batch and lot code on every bottle.
specs: Matte black screw cap with tamper band
Gold-foil mark and contour lines, printed direct
18 to 24 months, stored cool and out of the sun
products.serve: Serve cool, at 8 to 12 °C, straight from the bottle at the table. Keep it out of direct sunlight.

products.name: Black Water
products.lead: From a high-mountain spring in the north-western Himalaya, where the water runs through gneiss and ancient basalt and gathers its minerals on the way. Natural alkalinity gives it a clean, crisp finish.
products.story: In the shadow of craggy peaks, a hidden spring runs clear and cold through rock laid down by ancient lava flows. The stone gives the water its minerals and its natural alkalinity, pH 8.0 to 9.5. We bottle it cold to keep that character, in a swing-top glass bottle for the table and a clear 500 ml can for everywhere else.
products.metaDescription: OnyxAura Black Water: naturally alkaline Himalayan mountain water, pH 8.0 to 9.5. Swing-top glass bottle MRP ₹999, 500 ml can MRP ₹299, box of six ₹1,499.

source.terrain: Gneiss and basalt bedrock, mixed rocky forest
source.climate: Around 8 °C on average, with summer monsoon and winter snow
source.day: The flow is checked at dawn, while the mist still sits in the valley.

points: Naturally alkaline: pH 8.0 to 9.5, TDS 200 to 300 ppm.
Mineral-rich, from gneiss and ancient basalt.
Swing-top glass, a clear 500 ml can, or a box of six cans.
specs: Clear glass with a swing-top stopper, wire bail and seal
Clear body with an aluminium lid and pull tab
Matte black carton with a carry handle and a window
18 to 24 months, stored cool and out of the sun
products.serve: Serve cold, at 6 to 8 °C, in a tall glass. The swing-top reseals between pours.

products.name: Himalayan
products.tagline: Pristine Himalayan spring water, in a clear can.
products.lead: From a snow-fed spring in the Garhwal Himalaya, Uttarakhand, above 2,500 metres. The clear can lets you see exactly what you drink: crystal water, nothing hidden.
products.story: Himalayan water runs through deep shale and glacial gravel before it surfaces as a spring in the conifer forests of Garhwal. It is fed by the monsoon and by the winter snow, and it reaches us cold, clear and near neutral. Every can is tested and coded, and its clear body shows the water exactly as it is.
products.metaDescription: OnyxAura Himalayan: spring water from the Garhwal Himalaya, Uttarakhand, in a clear 500 ml can. pH 7.0 to 7.5, TDS 150 to 250 ppm. MRP ₹125. Order online.

products.name: Coconut
products.tagline: Young coconut water, sealed in a can. Coming soon.
products.lead: The water of young green coconuts from Karnataka, pressed, filtered and cold-filled into cans. No pulp, no preservatives. In preparation now.
products.story: Coconuts are harvested green, opened hygienically and their water filtered and cold-filled the same day, so nothing is added to keep it. Coconut water is naturally rich in potassium, around 250 mg in every 100 ml, with a light sweetness and a nutty finish that change a little with the season.
